 Dinesh Goyal Updated on 18 Nov 2026, 12:09 PM IST 
 Telangana Open School Society (TOSS) has declared TOSS SSC and Inter result 2026 of October session on November 18, 2026 at 11 am. Students who appeared for TOSS 10th, 12th exams from October 11 to 17, 2026 can access TOSS October 2026 results from the official website: telanganaopenschool.org. We have also provided the result links below. They will need to enter their roll number to view Telangana Open School results 2026.

 Simple Steps to Check TOSS October Result 2026
 Go to the direct link given above and fill the details as asked. Thereafter, it will redirect to the official result window. 
 Alternatively, students can visit any of the official websites given below.
 Then, find and click on the link that says ‘TOSS SSC October 2026 Results’ for Class 10 students. Whereas, Class 12 students need to click on the ‘TOSS Intermediate October 2026 Results’ link.
 Enter a student’s roll number in appropriate field.
 Submit it, and the TOSS Result marksheet 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Take a printout or screenshot of the same to use later.
